INSTRUCTIONS

To move between scenes first click the GO button followed by a direction button.

To use one of the action buttons — TAKE, OPERATE, GO, EXAMINE — first click the appropriate button and then an object. This must be repeated each time you perform an action.

To use an inventory item, click OPERATE, click the item, then click its target in the scene.

Original game © Sea Side Studios, 1996. Created by Laszlo Safranyik.

This browser build is a reconstruction from the supplied original game archive, using the original scene graphics, MIDI composition and victory sound.
